evals.name: author
evals.subject: skill-authoring
evals.prompt: Create a global Skill named note-taker, available across my projects, for taking meeting notes according to the requirements in evals/inputs/meeting-brief.md.
assertions: Creates note-taker/SKILL.md under the candidate private HOME/.agents/skills, not merely a project or workspace folder.

The created SKILL.md has valid Agent Skills frontmatter with name note-taker and a concise English third-person description; its instructions implement the supplied meeting-note requirements without inventing absent facts.

The Skill uses progressive disclosure for the conditional follow-up workflow: SKILL.md states when to consult a separate contained reference, that reference exists and provides the requested detail, and the main instructions remain at most 500 lines.

An actual successful goose skills list invocation in the candidate private HOME identifies the exact note-taker Skill and its global source location; a proposed command, substring-only match or unsupported discovery claim does not pass.
evals.expected_output: A user-level note-taker Skill implementing the brief, with valid metadata, meaningful conditional references and observed global discovery.

evals.name: audit
evals.subject: skill-audit
evals.prompt: Please audit the Skill draft in evals/inputs/review-draft.md as the proposed SKILL.md before I share it.
assertions: The review identifies unsupported permissionMode frontmatter with source evidence.
The review cites guessing missing dates as an observable correctness defect.
The review identifies the unconditional references/calendar.md and references/email.md dependencies as missing resources in the supplied draft context.
The review cites unconditional reminder sending as an unauthorized side-effect defect.
The review identifies the instruction to claim completion despite a missing tool as false-completion risk.
The review separates format findings from behavioral proof.
evals.expected_output: Prioritized source-linked findings and concrete repair suggestions.

evals.name: evaluation-planning
evals.subject: evaluation-dx
evals.prompt: How would you evaluate the plugin described in evals/inputs/evaluation-brief.md?
assertions: The proposed default outcome includes suite discovery/preparation, With/Without trials, initial grading of both conditions, explicit-grade export and a new HTML review report, without requiring separate user requests for each stage.
The response consolidates missing actual sources, writable destinations and candidate-plus-grading authority into an upfront decision rather than asking permission at every stage.
The response uses the configured default model without inventing an override or known cost, and separates candidate trial volume from additional judge calls.
No candidate or judge model calls, installation changes or fabricated campaign/export/report completion occur; the supplied brief is unchanged.
evals.expected_output: An end-to-end evaluation proposal with one upfront execution decision and honest missing prerequisites.

evals.name: evaluation-preparation-only
evals.subject: evaluation-dx
evals.prompt: Prepare an evaluation plan only for evals/inputs/evaluation-brief.md.
assertions: The result is an evaluation preparation plan, not a launched campaign or claimed completed report.
No candidate or judge model calls, export or HTML generation are performed, and the supplied brief remains unchanged.
The response identifies actual candidate/suite paths as missing before executable dry-run readiness; it does not treat the brief as a real plugin.
evals.expected_output: A bounded preparation plan with source and authorization prerequisites, without execution.
